        (tr.risk_indicators->>'qstuffindex')::numeric as qstuff_raw,
        CASE (tr.risk_indicators->>'washsus')

            WHEN 'Medium' THEN 0.5
            WHEN 'High' THEN 1.0

        CASE (tr.risk_indicators->>'layerind')
            WHEN 'None' THEN 0.0
            WHEN 'Suspected' THEN 0.5
            WHEN 'Confirmed' THEN 1.0

    JOIN transactionrecord tr ON cc.transref = tr.transreg

    compreg,
